hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $n = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon; $n.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Information; $n.Visible = $true; $n.ShowBalloonTip(5000, "Claude Code", "확인이 필요합니다", "Info"); Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; $n.Dispose()'
